title: Wheel Of Destiny

sourceFacts: The public main-wheel display array has50 entries with7.2degree positions and is used to render the target matching the server result. The separate betting grid has nine fields, not nine wheel segments. Matched3x and unmatched losses were directly observed.
unresolved: Uniform50 outcome tickets are independent operator probabilities, not inferred provider probabilities.
Nine multiplier fields and documented BONUS/DOUBLE transitions are implemented with independently authored uniform segment probabilities.
BONUS was not triggered in the twenty regular-only observed rounds; its rules and display tables are documented, while native feature outcomes and full artwork/audio/control parity remain unverified.
